module.purpose: Provides shared TypeScript utility types and runtime helpers for TanStack Router, including structural sharing, equality checks, URL normalization, protocol validation, promise coordination, and generic type manipulation.
module.summary: This module combines compile-time type utilities with runtime primitives used throughout router state management and navigation. It supports immutable structural sharing, deep equality, plain-object detection, updater evaluation, controlled asynchronous operations, URL decoding and encoding, protocol safety checks, HTML escaping, and development stylesheet URL construction. The runtime helpers are optimized for browser and server environments and preserve router-specific URL and serialization invariants.
module.businessContext: Supports client-side routing, SSR, navigation safety, and route-state comparison. Failures can cause incorrect redirects, XSS exposure, broken hydration, or unnecessary router updates.

/**
 * Re-encode characters that are unsafe in URL paths.
 * Includes ASCII control characters (0x00-0x1F, 0x7F) and a subset of the
 * WHATWG URL "path percent-encode set" (", <, >, `, {, }).
 *
 * Space (0x20) is intentionally excluded — decodeURI decodes %20 to space
 * and the router stores decoded spaces in location.pathname. The existing
 * encodePathLikeUrl already handles re-encoding spaces for outgoing URLs.
 *
 * These characters are decoded by decodeURI but must remain percent-encoded
